title: DocMap LOCAL sync journal entry (voce del Registro sincronizzazioni sul dispositivo)
description: One exchange of data seen from this device (jrNewEntry / jrAdd in assets/js/06i-journal.js): S.syncJournal (newest last, max 2000 entries / 12000 items), the workspace JSON key sync_journal, the phone vault list. The SERVER journal has its own shape (route journal, docs/python/openapi.yaml JournalEntry). Contract: docs/SYNC.md §9.

auto.description: true = automatic web-app sync (not asked by the user).

error.description: '' when ok; 'cancelled' when the user cancelled the review.

peer.description: The other side: a device of a package, 'server:<url>' or the phone's server.

device.description: jrClientInfo(): the identity also sent to the server (X-DocMap-Device / -Name / -App).

user.description: Operator name or the server user of the token.

role.description: Server role when known (viewer · editor · admin), else ''.

server_journal.description: jid of the matching server journal entries, when known.

items.description: At most 300 per entry; the oldest entries lose their items first (items_pruned).

seeded.description: Server sync that uploaded the whole archive to an empty server.

type.description: binder · client · location · settings · any future record type (open list).

action.description: Received (dir in): create · update · delete · tombstone (deletion of a record already absent here) · conflict · rejected-older (older than the local copy, ignored) · restore. Sent (dir out): sent · sent-delete; phone saves use update.

resolution.description: took_remote · kept_local · accepted · rejected-older · conflict · rejected-invalid · queued · forced · error (phone) · ''

hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON of the version kept / sent (= server new_hash).

snapshot.description: The record before a deletion, so that it can be restored.
